contract.claim: Averaging an actual integral finite-group comparison equivariant mod p^(e+k) produces a p-integral exact intertwiner congruent to it mod p^k, where e = v_p(|G|); unit determinant persists when k >= 1.
contract.arithmetic: Exact integers and fractions only. Fractions whose denominators are prime to p are elements of Z_(p), hence of Z_p. No floating point enters any decision.
contract.matrix_convention: Row-major 2 by 2 matrices acting on column vectors; rho(g) P = P tau(g); average = sum_g rho(g) A tau(g^-1)/|G|.
contract.actual_integral_actions: All actions are constructed over Z and their full group multiplication tables checked before any reduction. No torsion representation is presumed to have an integral lift.
contract.C2: Template diag(1,-1); every nonsingular frame in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^4, integral conjugate actions only, deduplicated; p=2; k=1,2; all four entries of A modulo 2^(1+k).
contract.C4: Faithful order-four rotation [[0,-1],[1,0]], conjugated by [[1,h],[0,1]] for h=-1,0,1; p=2, e=2, k=1; all A modulo 8. This checks e>1, without asserting e=2 is optimal for this particular action.
contract.S3: Permutation action on basis e0-e2,e1-e2; identity, upper-unit shear, lower-unit shear frames; p=2,3; e=k=1; all A modulo p^2, with every p^4 lift by one further entrywise digit for each equivariant residue.
contract.invertibility: All equivariant comparison matrices are included, even singular ones; unit preservation and conjugacy are checked only when det(A) is a p-adic unit.
contract.sharpness: Explicit C2 example; all 16 lifts of the prescribed mod-4 matrix to mod 8 fail equivariance, although its average preserves the mod-2 matrix.
contract.failure_interpretation: A failed invariant aborts with AssertionError; no partial count is recorded as a pass. A timeout is inconclusive.
limitations: Bounded implementation audit; not a universal proof of the lifting or completion theorems.
Only the stated actual integral finite-group actions and rational p-integral averages are tested.
No arbitrary torsion representation is claimed to lift integrally.
No Galois, Hodge-Tate, Weil-Deligne or arithmetic packet identification is inferred.
Group-order valuation gives a sufficient bound; this audit does not assert it is always optimal.
